Our expertise

Sanfreight brings together in-depth expertise in the field of real estate investment.

The diversity of profiles within our team enables us to develop and implement robust strategies, by internalizing the entire real estate value chain, from fund structuring to asset management within our portfolios. Our team manages a wide range of structures. Our knowledge of the market, combined with a high degree of flexibility and agility, enables us to offer investment solutions tailored to customer and market situations.

Private Equity funds

Private Equity fund structures enable our investors to pool their capital with limited dilution of their interest in redistributed capital gains.
This type of fund is ideally suited to professional investors who are accustomed to investing and optimizing their returns.

Club-Deals

Co-investments (i.e. joint ventures), which can be carried out via our dedicated funds or our Club Deals, enable us to collaborate with leading investors and partners.
The founders of Sanfreight have a long history of bringing together investment partners with common interests to invest in portfolios or single assets.

Capital Investment / Private debt

Private debt investments are transactions carried out outside regulated financial markets.
We structure transactions involving banks and alternative lenders, combining different capital structures (e.g. mezzanine debt, senior debt, whole loan, preferred equity, etc.).
